notes.title: Version 1.0!
notes.content:
Version 1.0 is now live! Many improvements have been made, and all that are remaining are purely visual. The 100% finished version should be done in January, but for now, the game should feel much better to play.

I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Version 0.9b is now avaliable!
notes.content:
Hey all!
Version 0.9b of the demo is now avaliable.
The game is now playable up until just right before the first boss.
There will be a new build released soon that continues the story as well!

notes.title: Version 0.85b and Mac Support
notes.content:
Hi all! With the release of version 0.85b, the game now has official Max support. This is something I was planning for a while, so I'm very happy to announce it. That being said, I am a native Windows user, and only used the Mac to package the game. Please let me know how it runs.

This update also contains a new section of the main story, that being the first part of Chapter 1. It's still very much in the developmental stage, so here is a guide on how to complete the first section (there are no ingame markers.)

[img]https://assets.zyrosite.com/A3QKOjBMeJHkz1v6/screenshot-2024-08-09-151817_11zon-dOq4D0KryDFWlaaJ.png[/img]

You have to walk to the areas in this order to properly complete this section. In a future update, 3D models will be there in place of the dev boxes. I felt like it was taking a long time and I wanted to release a new build, so I released it as-is for now. Hopefully you can see what I'm trying to accomplish.

The game is on track to have the full demo (version 1.0) released this year. At that time, the paid version will also become available. At first, the demo and paid versions will be the same, but the paid version will have access to chapters 2-6 when those are released. So yeah.

Thank you as always for being interested in the development of this game.

notes.title: Game Journal #97 Released!
notes.content:
Hello all!
I wrote a new journal about the game's progress on my website. If you didn't know, I've been chronicling its progress as I've been going along. I usually update the blog once a week.

This week, I've implemented the game's Investigation mode! Like Ace Attorney? Then you know what to expect!

Link to the journal here: https://haxdev.xyz/game-journal-97-investigation-mode 

Also, the game has a discord server and newsletter where you can sign up to get updates on the game as well. You can find the links on my website's homepage above!

Thank you for following the development of Joe Maverick: Legend of the Savior.

-HaxDev

notes.title: Version 0.5b released!
notes.content:
The following items have been added to the game:
-Opening movie
-Credits for Unreal Engine and Splash Screen
-Loading movie
-Update for soundroom. Now you can see what music is currently playing.
-The prologue has music, and images for the dialogue.
